description: Corner tile of a top-down pixel art fantasy world map: a cold northern sea in full daylight. Pale teal-blue polar water in the same bright daytime palette as the reference images, scattered small white drift-ice floes thinning toward the bottom edge, and one tiny dark cinder skerry with a thin white steam wisp near the top right. The bottom edge must blend into the open teal ocean of the 'sea' reference; the left edge must blend into the pack ice of the 'ice' reference. No dark navy water, no night tones. No text, no borders.

reference_images.usage: ice: the pack-ice terrain immediately west of this corner; continue it
sea: the ocean immediately south of this corner; match its water color at the bottom edge
